summary: Open the GIS module from the V4 launcher
description:
Basic V4 navigation smoke test. Start at https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/launcher and sign in if prompted.
Acceptance criteria:
The V4 launcher displays a GIS module card with an Open control.
Selecting Open on the GIS card opens the GIS module page on the same V4 host without an application load error.

guideImpact.reason: The verified behaviour introduces a user-facing navigation path: users open the GIS module from a GIS card in the V4 launcher. The guide should explain where to find the card and how to use its Open control.
